item.title: U.S. Space Force strengthens partnerships at 45th Cobra Gold
item.description: CAMP RED HORSE, RAYONG, Thailand – Members of the U.S. Space Force participate in the 45th iteration of Cobra Gold for the first time in the exercise’s history, marking a milestone for the service and further integrating space as a warfighting domain within one of the Indo Pacific’s largest multinational exercises, Feb. 23 to March 6. item.title: U.S. Marine Corps General Takes Command of Fully Integrated Norwegian-American Logistics Headquarters
item.description: KJELLER AIR BASE, NORWAY – U.S. Marine Corps Brig. Gen. Maura M. Hennigan, commanding general of 2nd Marine Logistics Group, assumed command of the Combined Joint Logistics Support Group (CJLSG) from Norwegian army Brig. Gen. Nina S. Berg in a transfer of authority ceremony here, February 27, 2026.

item.title: Saint Kitts and Nevis Moves Toward National Hearing Program With Support From U.S. Air Force Audiologists
item.description: BASSETERRE, Saint Kitts — For many families across Saint Kitts and Nevis hearing care has long meant limited access. The two-island Federation relies on a single ear, nose and throat specialist, leaving many residents without consistent access to comprehensive hearing care. item.title: U.S. Forces Launch Operation Epic Fury
item.description: TAMPA, Fla. – U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) commenced Operation Epic Fury, Feb. 28, at the direction of the President of the United States.

item.title: Photo Story: 68W Sustainment Training operations at Fort McCoy, Part 1
item.description: Army Reserve combat medics participate in training Feb. 23, 2026, for 68W Sustainment Training at a building coordinated through the Medical Simulations Training Center at Fort McCoy, Wis.

item.title: 10th Mountain Division (LI) honors its historic climb to glory
item.description: The 10th Mountain Division (LI) carries on the legacy of its forebears, the original 10th mountaineers. The division's return to Colorado celebrates their historic beginning, which was formed during World War II from elite skiers, climbers, and alpinists to fight in rugged, mountainous terrain.

item.title: Chief Master Sgt. Rankin takes reins as 145th Airlift Wing command chief
item.description: CHARLOTTE, N.C. - U.S. Air Force Chief Master Sgt. Tracie B. Rankin assumed responsibility as the 145th Airlift Wing (AW) command chief from Chief Master Sgt. Jeremy S. Mullins during a change of responsibility ceremony held at the Charlotte Air National Guard base, Feb. 27, 2026.
